name: Hornero Focus Card
description: Focus Card 2.0: dashboard card with the locale date and a rotating original one-line focus reminder, from PluginKit Time. Keyboard Previous/Next and pause, optional own leading line, no processes or network.
author: HorneroOS contributors

changelog.notes: Notes and Focus 2.0: locale-formatted date from the shared Time facade instead of the hard-coded Spanish layout and own date object, keyboard Previous/Next plus pause replacing the mouse-only card click, Ui primitives with Theme tokens, typed settings with 1.x defaults (30 s rotation, date shown, built-in lines only) plus an optional custom leading line, and Argentine Spanish catalog.
Dashboard card with a rotating original one-line focus reminder and the date.

rotateSeconds.description: Seconds each focus line stays on screen (30 in 1.x).

customLine.description: Optional own focus line, shown first in the rotation. Empty (the 1.x behaviour) rotates the built-in lines only.
